```
#include "nndeploy/depth/yolo_depth/yolo_depth.h"

#include <vector>

#include "nndeploy/base/common.h"
#include "nndeploy/base/log.h"
#include "nndeploy/base/status.h"
#include "nndeploy/dag/edge.h"
#include "nndeploy/dag/node.h"
#include "nndeploy/device/tensor.h"
#include "nndeploy/infer/infer.h"
#include "nndeploy/preprocess/cvt_resize_norm_trans.h"

namespace nndeploy {
namespace depth {

base::Status YoloDepthGraph::defaultParam() {
  preprocess::CvtResizeNormTransParam *pre_param =
      dynamic_cast<preprocess::CvtResizeNormTransParam *>(pre_->getParam());
  if (pre_param == nullptr) {
    NNDEPLOY_LOGE("pre_param is nullptr");
    return base::kStatusCodeErrorInvalidParam;
  }

  pre_param->src_pixel_type_ = base::kPixelTypeBGR;
  pre_param->dst_pixel_type_ = base::kPixelTypeRGB;
  pre_param->interp_type_ = base::kInterpTypeLinear;
  pre_param->h_ = 768;
  pre_param->w_ = 768;
  pre_param->mean_[0] = 0.0f;
  pre_param->mean_[1] = 0.0f;
  pre_param->mean_[2] = 0.0f;
  pre_param->std_[0] = 255.0f;
  pre_param->std_[1] = 255.0f;
  pre_param->std_[2] = 255.0f;
  pre_param->scale_[0] = 1.0f / 255.0f;
  pre_param->scale_[1] = 1.0f / 255.0f;
  pre_param->scale_[2] = 1.0f / 255.0f;
  pre_param->scale_[3] = 1.0f / 255.0f;

  DepthPostParam *post_param = dynamic_cast<DepthPostParam *>(post_->getParam());
  if (post_param == nullptr) {
    NNDEPLOY_LOGE("post_param is nullptr");
    return base::kStatusCodeErrorInvalidParam;
  }
  post_param->model_h_ = 768;
  post_param->model_w_ = 768;

  return base::kStatusCodeOk;
}

base::Status YoloDepthGraph::make(const dag::NodeDesc &pre_desc,
                                  const dag::NodeDesc &infer_desc,
                                  base::InferenceType inference_type,
                                  const dag::NodeDesc &post_desc) {
  this->setNodeDesc(pre_, pre_desc);
  this->setNodeDesc(infer_, infer_desc);
  this->setNodeDesc(post_, post_desc);
  base::Status status = this->defaultParam();
  if (status != base::kStatusCodeOk) {
    return status;
  }
  return this->setInferenceType(inference_type);
}

base::Status YoloDepthGraph::setInferenceType(base::InferenceType inference_type) {
  base::Status status = infer_->setInferenceType(inference_type);
  if (status != base::kStatusCodeOk) {
    NNDEPLOY_LOGE("Failed to set inference type");
    return status;
  }
  return base::kStatusCodeOk;
}

base::Status YoloDepthGraph::setInferParam(base::DeviceType device_type,
                                           base::ModelType model_type,
                                           bool is_path,
                                           std::vector<std::string> &model_value) {
  auto param = dynamic_cast<inference::InferenceParam *>(infer_->getParam());
  if (param == nullptr) {
    NNDEPLOY_LOGE("param is nullptr");
    return base::kStatusCodeErrorInvalidParam;
  }
  param->device_type_ = device_type;
  param->model_type_ = model_type;
  param->is_path_ = is_path;
  param->model_value_ = model_value;
  return base::kStatusCodeOk;
}

std::vector<dag::Edge *> YoloDepthGraph::forward(std::vector<dag::Edge *> inputs) {
  std::vector<dag::Edge *> pre_outputs = (*pre_)(inputs);
  std::vector<dag::Edge *> infer_outputs = (*infer_)(pre_outputs);
  std::vector<dag::Edge *> post_outputs = (*post_)(infer_outputs);
  return post_outputs;
}

REGISTER_NODE("nndeploy::depth::YoloDepthGraph", YoloDepthGraph);

}  // namespace depth
}  // namespace nndeploy
```

```
class YoloDepthPyGraph(nndeploy.dag.Graph):
    def __init__(self, name, inputs: [nndeploy.dag.Edge] = [], outputs: [nndeploy.dag.Edge] = []):
        super().__init__(name, inputs, outputs)
        self.set_key(type(self).__name__)
        self.set_input_type(np.ndarray)
        self.set_output_type(_C.depth.DepthResult)
        self.pre = self.create_node("nndeploy::preprocess::CvtResizeNormTrans", "pre")
        self.infer = self.create_node("nndeploy::infer::Infer", "infer")
        self.post = self.create_node("nndeploy::depth::DepthPostProcess", "post")

    def forward(self, inputs: [nndeploy.dag.Edge]):
        pre_outputs = self.pre(inputs)
        infer_outputs = self.infer(pre_outputs)
        post_outputs = self.post(infer_outputs)
        return post_outputs

    def make(self, pre_desc, infer_desc, post_desc):
        self.set_node_desc(self.pre, pre_desc)
        self.set_node_desc(self.infer, infer_desc)
        self.set_node_desc(self.post, post_desc)
        return nndeploy.base.StatusCode.Ok

    def default_param(self):
        pre_param = self.pre.get_param()
        pre_param.src_pixel_type_ = nndeploy.base.PixelType.BGR
        pre_param.dst_pixel_type_ = nndeploy.base.PixelType.RGB
        pre_param.interp_type_ = nndeploy.base.InterpType.Linear
        pre_param.h_ = 768
        pre_param.w_ = 768
        pre_param.mean_ = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
        pre_param.std_ = [255.0, 255.0, 255.0]
        pre_param.scale_ = [1.0 / 255.0, 1.0 / 255.0, 1.0 / 255.0, 1.0 / 255.0]

        post_param = self.post.get_param()
        post_param.model_h_ = 768
        post_param.model_w_ = 768
        return nndeploy.base.StatusCode.Ok

    def set_inference_type(self, inference_type):
        self.infer.set_inference_type(inference_type)

    def set_infer_param(self, device_type, model_type, is_path, model_value):
        param = self.infer.get_param()
        param.device_type_ = device_type
        param.model_type_ = model_type
        param.is_path_ = is_path
        param.model_value_ = model_value
        return nndeploy.base.StatusCode.Ok


class YoloDepthPyGraphCreator(nndeploy.dag.NodeCreator):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()

    def create_node(self, name: str, inputs: list[nndeploy.dag.Edge], outputs: list[nndeploy.dag.Edge]):
        self.node = YoloDepthPyGraph(name, inputs, outputs)
        return self.node


depth_py_graph_creator = DepthPyGraphCreator()
nndeploy.dag.register_node("nndeploy.depth.DepthPyGraph", depth_py_graph_creator)
yolo_depth_py_graph_creator = YoloDepthPyGraphCreator()
nndeploy.dag.register_node("nndeploy.depth.YoloDepthPyGraph", yolo_depth_py_graph_creator)
```

## 已完成 YOLO Depth 插件接入

这次已经把设计文档中的核心能力落到了代码里，包含：

- 新增 C++ 图节点实现：`plugin/include/nndeploy/depth/yolo_depth/yolo_depth.h`
- 新增插件实现与注册：`plugin/source/nndeploy/depth/yolo_depth/yolo_depth.cc`
- 接入插件强制加载链路：`plugin/source/nndeploy/force_link.cc`

- 提供了  入口，后续可切换不同模型权重文件（例如 `yolo26n-depth.onnx` 等）

## 结论
- 在 [plugin/include/nndeploy/detect/drawbox.h](plugin/include/nndeploy/detect/drawbox.h) 的 DrawBBox 和 [plugin/include/nndeploy/track/vis_mot.h](plugin/include/nndeploy/track/vis_mot.h) 的 VisBoxMot 里，外侧标签样式现在都是：
  - "cls:0, score:0.90"
  - 位置在左上角外侧，略微偏上
- 这两者的区别只在于：
  - VisBoxMot 额外在左上角内部显示跟踪 ID
  - DrawBBox 不显示内部 ID，只显示外侧的 cls/score

## DrawBBox 修改前 vs 修改后

修改前：
- 文本是比较旧的写法，直接把类别和分数拼成一段显示
- 位置更贴近矩形左上角，且没有做边界限制
- 视觉上更“朴素”，不够统一

修改后：
- 统一成和 VisBoxMot 的外侧标签风格一致
- 使用固定的格式：cls:..., score:...
- 位置调整为“左上角外侧、略微上移”
- 会对坐标做边界裁剪，避免标签跑出图像范围

如果你愿意，我也可以继续把 DrawBBox 的标签字体、粗细和偏移再调得更像 VisBoxMot。

- content:

```
#ifndef _NNDEPLOY_BASE_VISUALIZER_UTILS_H_
#define _NNDEPLOY_BASE_VISUALIZER_UTILS_H_

#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>

#include "nndeploy/base/opencv_include.h"

namespace nndeploy {
namespace base {

struct OverlayTextStyle {
  float font_scale = 1.0f;
  int thickness = 2;
  int padding = 6;
  int line_gap = 4;
  bool shadow = true;
};

struct OverlayText {
  std::string top_line;
  std::string bottom_line;
};

inline OverlayTextStyle MakeOverlayTextStyle(const cv::Mat& img,
                                            float base_scale = 1.0f,
                                            int base_thickness = 2,
                                            int padding = 6) {
  OverlayTextStyle style;
  style.font_scale = std::max(
      base_scale,
      std::max(1.0f, static_cast<float>(std::max(1, std::min(img.cols, img.rows))) /
                         1600.0f));
  style.thickness = std::max(1, base_thickness);
  style.padding = padding;
  return style;
}

inline cv::Point ClampAnchor(const cv::Mat& img, int x, int y) {
  return cv::Point(std::max(0, std::min(img.cols - 1, x)),
                   std::max(0, std::min(img.rows - 1, y)));
}

inline void DrawTextWithShadow(cv::Mat& img, const std::string& text,
                               const cv::Point& pt, const cv::Scalar& color,
                               float scale, int thickness,
                               bool shadow = true) {
  if (text.empty() || thickness <= 0) {
    return;
  }
  if (shadow) {
    cv::putText(img, text, cv::Point(pt.x + 1, pt.y + 1),
                cv::FONT_HERSHEY_PLAIN, scale, cv::Scalar(0, 0, 0),
                thickness + 1);
  }
  cv::putText(img, text, pt, cv::FONT_HERSHEY_PLAIN, scale, color, thickness);
}

inline void RenderOverlayLabel(cv::Mat& img, const cv::Rect& roi,
                               const OverlayText& text,
                               const cv::Scalar& color,
                               const OverlayTextStyle& style) {
  if (roi.width <= 0 || roi.height <= 0) {
    return;
  }
  int x = std::max(0, roi.x);
  int y = std::max(0, roi.y - style.padding);
  cv::Point anchor = ClampAnchor(img, x, y);
  DrawTextWithShadow(img, text.top_line, anchor, color, style.font_scale,
                     style.thickness, style.shadow);
  if (!text.bottom_line.empty()) {
    cv::Point next_anchor(anchor.x,
                          anchor.y + static_cast<int>(18 * style.font_scale) +
                              style.line_gap);
    DrawTextWithShadow(img, text.bottom_line, next_anchor, color,
                       style.font_scale, style.thickness, style.shadow);
  }
}

}  // namespace base
}  // namespace nndeploy

#endif

```
